description: This file defines the Payment controller class for the OpenCart admin extension system. It manages listing, installation, and uninstallation of payment extensions within the admin panel, including handling permissions, loading language strings, and constructing URLs for extension actions.

classes.name: Payment
classes.description: Controller class for managing payment extensions in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the list of payment extensions by calling getList and setting the output.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Loads language strings, reads available extension files, checks installed extensions, and prepares data for the view of payment extensions.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation of a payment extension, including permissions, autoload registration, and invoking optional install routines.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation of a payment extension, including permissions and invoking optional uninstall routines.
